display_information.name: Kaffi
display_information.description: Office coffee leaderboards from the kaffi knob
display_information.long_description:
*Kaffi* posts the office coffee leaderboard to Slack.

Each office has a kaffi knob by the coffee machine. Turn it to pick your name, tap to log that you brewed a pot or took a cup. Brewing earns credit, taking cups spends it. Positive balance makes you a hero, negative makes you a freeloader, and streaks reward the people who brew on consecutive weekdays.

On a schedule, Kaffi posts that scoreboard to each office's channel in the office's local time. Invite @Kaffi to a channel to get your office's leaderboard there.
